scope: W11 release processing preflight and L05 baseline

hosted/test/mixer_hosted/releases/browse.setupCorrection: The first private cluster omitted the catalogue definer role from the maintained collector. The corrected fresh cluster used its exact role attributes.

transactionProbe.condition: The fixture writer has INSERT(queue,worker,args), SELECT(id), and separate schema and sequence USAGE.

designDecision.producer: Enqueue an exact fresh publication on the same Repo checkout and authorization transaction that writes the head. Persist the three job columns and use PostgreSQL defaults.
designDecision.processor: Materialize the exact committed publication through a restricted Oban role in a dedicated schema of the same database.
designDecision.serving: Continue to read the committed ledger during this slice. Independent release serving still needs its own qualification.
designDecision.review: Both source designs selected the dedicated schema and immutable projection. The transaction probe corrected the proposed insert operation without broadening privileges.

limits: The transaction discriminator used synthetic head rows and the actual prefixed Oban table. It does not exercise the future release job migration, live publication, or processor.
